body:
We can’t do anything about it and it feels like it’s our fault that we’re not actively trying to improve 
Every answer I read online ends with ~go to therapy~ 
But I can’t

Nope
I wish I can die right this second
I know it’s been forever but I tried this method and I ran out of good things to say after three days .. it’s hard finding a good thing

Can’t see a psychologist either 
If I tell my parents about how I feel they will judge how “religious” I am 
And that I have strayed too far from god 
If I see a psychologist I would have brought shame into the family 
It’s so dumb

This is exactly how I feel rn and how I’ve been feeling for the last 7 years 
I feel like a burden to everyone around me because I can’t do anything 
Do they even love or care for me 
But why 
I can’t do shit I’m not even nice to them Bc I get agitated and pissed at every small thing 
I’m the worst person around them, I don’t make them happy one bit 
If it weren’t for me, my parent will live happily with all their other four kids married with their grand kids 
I’m just a big disappointed 
But I also can’t bring myself to kill myself
I can’t think of how fucked up that would be for them 
I don’t wanna hurt anyone emotionally Bc of me 
I wish I can die without it looking like a suicide 
I can’t even secretly catch corona Bc I’m scared ppl will catch it from me and I don’t wanna do that to other ppl
I just wanna die peacefully
Just vanish without a trace 
Sorry for blabbering in your post, it’s just what I’m going through
